artifacts.summary: Locates the two live call sites (orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh and reconcile-task-status.sh) needed to mechanically anchor the Sapience postflight wrapup write, and recommends a sapience_notes field plus a skill_propagate_sapience_notes function mirroring the existing memory_candidates pattern.

memory_candidates.content: In this codebase, a skill-base.sh skill_propagate_* function's mere existence does not imply it is wired into any live completion path -- skill_propagate_memory_candidates is fully implemented but has zero live callers across orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh, orchestrate-stage5-postflight.sh, and reconcile-task-status.sh. Verify wiring by grepping the function's own name across those three files, never by inferring from its presence in skill-base.sh.

The live implement-completed status transition has two structurally independent call sites in this codebase: skill_postflight_update (skill-base.sh, used by orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh and command-gate-out.sh) for the normal path, and reconcile-task-status.sh's implementing)/partial) arms, which call update-task-status.sh postflight directly, bypassing skill_postflight_update and skill_orchestrate_propagate_completion entirely. Any new postflight-completion propagation (e.g. a new .return-meta.json field consumer) must be wired at both sites to cover the deferred/deploy-gate-refusal completion path, not just the normal one.
